title: LifeMD (LFMD) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Analysts Lower Targets On Weaker Guidance
desc: LifeMD is back in focus after fair value in the updated model shifted from US$9.88 to US$8.13, an adjustment of about 18% that aligns with lower Street price targets in recent research. Analysts have been resetting expectations following the latest Q2 report and guidance, with some still pointing to long term growth drivers while acknowledging nearer term pressure on revenue and earnings outlooks. In the sections that follow, you will see how this evolving narrative around LifeMD might shape...
